description: A function `(Component) => EnhancedComponent` that wraps a component to add behavior or data.
A HOC consumes its own props and spreads the rest onto the wrapped component so the wrapper stays transparent.
Static name shown in React DevTools and warnings. Convention: `withX(Inner)` sets `WithX(InnerName)`.
Deep trees of HOC wrappers that make DevTools and prop origins hard to follow. Custom hooks avoid it.
Legacy helper that copied static methods from the wrapped component to the HOC output.
